Era labels are Hui of Western Jin: 惠帝即位 = 太熙/永熙元年 (AD 290); 元康元年 (AD 291); 九年十二月 is 元康九年十二月, which the verified month table places wholly in proleptic Gregorian AD 300 (300-01-08 to 300-02-06; Julian agrees before March 300). 明年正月 / 永康元年 months 1–6 remain AD 300; 永甯元年正月 is the chapter’s name for the 301 first month (contemporary 永康二年); 太安元年三月 is the chapter’s name for spring 302 (contemporary 永寧二年三月, 癸卯 present). Ages 五歲 and 二十三 are kept as sui; no birth year is inferred. Fathers named only as parents stay undated. Retrospective exempla (Xuan, Yang, Shen Sheng, Xiao Ji, Chu Jian, Li) are not treated as life activity. Posthumous 追封/追諡 stay off living hints. The chapter’s 六月己卯 burial day does not exist in Yongkang 1 month 6 (annals 六月壬寅), but the burial year is still AD 300. Hui-annals months 五月 vs 四月/八月 for Zang and Shang compete inside the same Western years and were not collapsed to false precision. All owned item and person checks are supported.
